tools.name: plan_trip
tools.description: For a request to plan a trip with a budget. Plans a whole trip, home to home, against the traveller's total budget: flights, stays, transfers, activities, visas and daily costs. Returns up to six options, each with a Safe Trip Total (the whole trip with a contingency), the route, and every price lab

tools.name: get_trip
tools.description: Reads a trip already planned on Trip720, by its trip id: its status and, when ready, its options with every labelled price and booking link. Read only; trips are kept 30 days.

tools.name: get_day_plan
tools.description: The day-by-day plan of one option of a trip already planned on Trip720 (the recommended option unless optionId is given): times, places and prices for each day. Read only; times marked typical are not from a timetable.

tools.name: trip_alternatives
tools.description: For one line of an option in a trip already planned on Trip720 (a stay, a flight, a transfer, an activity), the other choices the providers offer, numbered, each with its price and what it does to the whole trip's Safe Trip Total and budget. Line ids and option ids come from plan_trip or get_trip. R

tools.name: swap_trip_item
tools.description: Replaces one line of an option with one of the numbered choices from trip_alternatives, and re-prices the whole trip as the website does. Returns the updated option and its Safe Trip Total before and after. Side effect: the trip saved on Trip720 changes; the previous choice can be chosen again the s

tools.name: destination_facts
tools.description: Trip720's checked facts for one destination, for travellers from Australia or the UK: what a day costs a person for food and getting around (street food, balanced, mostly restaurants), local transport and taxi prices, tourist tax, the most pleasant months, the visa for that home country, the sights

tools.name: check_entry_requirements
tools.description: Whether travellers need a visa or an electronic authorisation for a holiday, for each passport and each destination country: the rule's name, the minimum processing days and its source (official government pages where available). Read only.

tools.name: best_time_to_visit
tools.description: When to go to a country, month by month: the best months overall, each covered place's most pleasant months, and the busy holiday weeks to plan around. From climate data (NASA POWER) and Trip720's research. Read only.
